p: sat before me: He shows the hypocrisy of the idolaters, who will pretend to hear the prophets of God, though in their hearts they follow nothing less than their admonitions and also how by one means or another God discovers them.

heart: They are not only idolaters in heart, but also worship their filthy idols openly which lead them in blindness, and cause them to stumble, so that he will not hear them when they call to him. See Geneva "Isa 1:15"
prophet: To inquire of things which the Lord has appointed to come to pass.
of his idols: As his abomination has deserved: that is, he will be led with lies according as he delighted in it, 2Th 2:10.
I may take the house of: That is, convince them by their own conscience.

deceived when he hath spoken a: The prophet declares that God for man's ingratitude raises up false prophets to seduce them that delight in lies rather than in the truth of God, and thus he punishes sin with sin, 1Ki 22:20,22 and destroys those prophets as well as the people.
Israel may no more go astray: Thus God's judgments against the wicked are admonitions to the godly to cleave to the Lord and not to defile themselves with the same abominations.
and will break the staff of: Read Eze 4:16,5:17, Isa 3:1.

Noah: Though Noah and Job were now alive, which in their time were most godly men (for at this time Daniel was in captivity with Ezekiel) and so these three together would pray for this wicked people, yet I would not hear them, read Jer 15:1.

righteousness: Meaning, that a very few (which he calls the remnant, Eze 14:22) would escape these plagues, whom God has sanctified and made righteous, so that this righteousness is a sign that they are the Church of God, whom he would preserve for his own sake.
remnant that shall be brought forth: Read Geneva "Eze 5:3"
